title: The Last Voice on Channel Nine

setting.station: Blackpine Relay, raised wooden building on steep pine ridge, rainy midnight
setting.floorplan: front porch/entrance -> main radio desk room with downhill window -> narrow rear hallway/cabinet -> rear exit/car; outside window is ten feet above downhill ground
setting.home: Lena house: open front door, warm hall telephone, dark stairs to upstairs bedroom

characters.Daniel: 32, olive skin, short wavy dark hair, stubble, brown canvas field jacket/charcoal hoodie, left palm scar; first-person narrator
characters.Lena: adult29 sister, curly dark hair, blue sleep shirt, at home throughout
characters.double: Daniel appearance, right palm scar, wrong closed smile; not an unrelated masked killer

rules: A voice connection lets the presence move toward the answered endpoint.
The entity learns/repeats voices; supposed four-minute future may be manipulation rather than a trustworthy prophecy.
Daniel first identifies himself during normal radio check, giving a reason the station knows his name and voice.
The landline connection to Lena is opened in section04, before the antenna is disconnected.
Disconnecting the antenna suppresses station manifestations but does not sever the telephone path.
Daniel almost calls again from the road but ends the call before answer; this is too late to undo section04.
The ending pays off the untouched telephone line and the repeated three knocks.

clues_and_payoffs.payoff: copied voice/name is not unearned knowledge
the warning helps cause the described outcome, making it unreliable
opens cabinet with both antenna and telephone junction

clues_and_payoffs.clue: radio speaks Lena words before telephone

clues_and_payoffs.payoff: double is not Daniel seen outside
presence already reached Lena house via earlier answered call

visual_constraints: single image per shot at source>=1280x720
no title bars/counters or camera motion
Clock in opening reads12:13; later mug scene reads12:17, or hide unreadable dial rather than render contradictory time.
Broken mug has three main pieces; double right palm scar must not become narrator left palm scar.
scope: 112 candidate concepts;96 selected audio-timed shots; no new image generated
safety_of_representation: All characters adult fiction; no real victim/suspect portrayed; no gore
